title: Supported counit and invertibility for the specified integral proper/open mate
statement: For the Operations and Realizations of [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization], in every commuting square kp=ri of proper vertical maps and quasi-compact open horizontal maps, the target open counit is invertible on the proper direct image of an open extension of every unbounded system input. Consequently the specified intrinsic proper/open gamma is a natural isomorphism. No restriction on derived inputs or faithfulness of evaluation on derived morphisms is used.

source.place: Tags 0F7B--0F7K; agent expansion of the blueprint composition/refinement calculation

proof.text: Evaluate at positive coefficient level n+1. The recorded direct-image and open-extension comparisons identify the evaluated target with the finite proper image of an open extension. Apply proper/open square support.

The recorded open-evaluation transpose and the mate counit equation identify the evaluated system counit with that finite counit up to invertible comparisons. Joint conservativity of actual derived coefficient evaluations implies the system counit is invertible. This uses detection of isomorphisms, not faithfulness on maps.

Apply the open adjunction Hom bijection to the recorded adjunct equation for gamma. The inverse bijection writes gamma as open extension of inverse lambda followed by the supported counit. Each component is invertible; hence gamma is invertible.

proof_origin.place: Proper/open support and the composition/refinement counit calculation
